alternatives_rejected.candidate: frontend: errors are a downstream symptom of recommendationservice
alternatives_rejected.why: frontend-external_error spikes (E1), but recommendationservice's own span self-time rose 5.29x and its inbound latency rose 17.84x (E2), so the fault sits in recommendationservice and frontend only sees the effect.

A pure delay injection would raise latency without a large change in socket usage, yet recommendationservice_socket deviates z=106.99 (+535%) alongside the latency (E1), which points to a socket fault.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice's socket and connection state (open sockets, connection pool, file-descriptor limits, any injected socket fault). Remove the fault or restart the recommendationservice pods to clear exhausted sockets, then confirm p50/p90 latency and frontend errors return to baseline.
